exceptions.reason: Preserve caller-visible UPPER_SNAKE_CASE process and container environment spellings for the managed listener FD/socket/port/run/namespace/lease/attempt bindings, Node and Kestrel launch admission, and the final Docker publisher activation gate. The canonical port allocator, container reservation owner, Vite adapter and backend composition consume these bindings through existing internal camelCase/PascalCase options and members.
